_help: Decision gate config (project-owned; the kit installer never overwrites it).
mode: off = does nothing | advisory = reports, never blocks | required = anything but 'ready' fails, and git push / gh pr create need a fresh 'ready' receipt.
checks: deterministic commands run first, in order (copy them from .ai/rules.md section 0). If any fails, the model is not asked.
provider.url: laya-serve (default port 8000), vega_server.py (8765) or https://api.typesafe.ai for Jev. Remote URLs are refused for private repos.
provider.model: sent as 'model' (e.g. jev-1.13.0). provider.expected_model: refuse answers from any other model.
questions: noul = yes/no probability; pass_when {max|min} on P(yes); choice: {in: [...]}; score: {min|max}. Answers below min_confidence count as unsure.
Run `python .claude/god/decide/decision_gate.py calibrate --data labelled.jsonl` before trusting thresholds.

high_risk.instructions: Does this change alter money or payment calculations, authentication or authorization, data deletion, database schema or migrations, or concurrent or background processing?
high_risk.on_fail: High-risk area: run the qa-skeptic agent; for payments, auth or migrations also run /second-opinion.

unfinished.instructions: Does the diff add unfinished work: TODO or FIXME notes, debug output, commented-out code, placeholder values, or skipped or disabled tests?
unfinished.on_fail: Finish or remove leftover TODOs, debug output, placeholders or skipped tests.

unrelated.instructions: Does the diff contain changes unrelated to the task goal?
unrelated.on_fail: Split unrelated changes into their own task, or explain them in .ai/memory/state.md.

complete.instructions: Does the diff fully implement the task goal, including tests for the new behaviour?
complete.on_fail: The change may not fully implement the goal: compare it with the task; add missing parts or tests.
